dct_creator_sm: Prince Edward Island Government Open Data Portal.
dct_description_sm:
A comprehensive geospatial dataset containing all officially assigned civic addresses within Prince 
Edward Island. Each record includes address number, street name, community, geographic coordinates, 
and related administrative attributes. This dataset supports emergency response, land administration, 
service delivery, and mapping applications.

Each row represents a single civic address point assigned within Prince Edward Island.
